questions.q: The hotel lobby has a ______ table near the entrance.
questions.exp: 意見（beautiful）→形狀（round）→材質（glass），材質最靠近名詞。

opts: The children were asleep when we arrived.
The asleep children didn't hear us.
Only alive plants are allowed in the lobby.
questions.exp: asleep、alone、alive 這類 a- 開頭的形容詞只放在連綴動詞後面（were asleep），不放名詞前面。

questions.q: Only employees with two years of service are eligible ______ the training program.
questions.exp: 有資格得到某樣東西：eligible for＋名詞。

questions.q: The old printer is so unreliable that it ______ works anymore.
questions.exp: 「不可靠到幾乎不能用」，用 hardly（幾乎不）。hard 是「努力地、用力地」。

questions.q: Ms. Ahn is the most productive salesperson ______ the region.
questions.exp: 範圍是單一的地方（the region），最高級後面用 in；of 用在一群的複數（of the five candidates）。

questions.q: The revised plan is ______ more practical than the original one.
questions.exp: 加強比較級用 much（far、a lot、even 也可以），不用 very。

questions.q: Ms. Ito is one of the most reliable ______ in our department.
questions.exp: one of the＋最高級＋複數名詞：從一群員工裡挑一個，所以用 employees。

questions.q: We hired twice as ______ temporary workers this summer as last summer.
questions.exp: 倍數＋as…as，中間的複數名詞（workers）前面用 many：twice as many workers as。

questions.q: The more we advertise, the ______ our sales become.
questions.exp: The＋比較級…, the＋比較級…：越多廣告，業績越高。more 不能跟 -er 一起用。

questions.q: It was ______ an easy decision that the board approved it in five minutes.
questions.exp: 後面是 an＋形容詞＋名詞（an easy decision），用 such…that。so 要直接接形容詞。
